Input documents bounded at256MiB. JSONL stream parts at most128MiB each, deterministic indexed filenames, contiguous indexes, exact row/byte counts, strict UTF8 unique-key finite JSON and complete LF lines, SHA256 for every part and index. Stream verification; no monolithic recombination.

Reject missing/extra/reordered/duplicate/tampered/truncated parts, path traversal, symlinks or inconsistent index identities. Bound lines/records; retain truthful partials and refuse oversize rows rather than split semantic records silently.

Do not invent complete counts on generation/worker/storage failure. Candidate, baseline and generator remain real separate processes; observer custody and native authority must not be fixture-bypassed in production.

Separate shared generation, setup, failed work, predicate/trace/search/list construction, conversion/public checks, host references, I/O and memory costs; no isolated wall or full native cost qualification is added.
